meta.name: plan-feature
meta.description: Pre-implementation planning — interview to clarify scope, then compile into a PRD. Triggers "help me figure out", "vague scope", "define requirements" (discovery phase); "PRD", "requirements document", "product spec", "feature spec", "write requirements" (PRD phase).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将模糊需求转化为结构化PRD文档
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你经常需要梳理模糊的产品需求并输出PRD
copy.tagline_en: Turn vague requirements into structured PRD documents
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to clarify fuzzy product requirements and output a PRD

howto.what: Claude会通过提问帮你梳理需求范围，然后整理成一份完整的PRD（产品需求文档）。
howto.when: 当你说出“帮我理清需求”、“PRD”、“定义需求”等关键词，或要求编写需求文档时触发。

say.text: 帮我理清这个新功能的需求范围
say.note: Claude会开始提问，帮你明确目标、范围、约束等
Claude会先提问确认细节，然后生成PRD文档

say.text: 我需要定义需求，但不太清楚从哪里开始
say.note: Claude会引导你完成需求澄清过程

howto.what_en: Claude interviews you to clarify requirements and scope, then compiles the output into a complete PRD (Product Requirements Document).
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention "help me figure out", "vague scope", "define requirements" (discovery phase); or "PRD", "requirements document", "product spec", "write requirements" (PRD phase).

say_en.text: Help me clarify the scope of this new feature
say_en.note: Claude will ask questions to understand goals, constraints, and details.

say_en.text: Write a PRD for this feature
say_en.note: Claude will gather details first, then produce a structured PRD.

say_en.text: I need to define requirements but I'm not sure where to start
say_en.note: Claude will guide you through a discovery interview.
